<script>
addEventListener('load',()=>{
  const tolerance=1;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-audit-state]')].map(row=>{
    const state=row.dataset.auditState;
    const badge=row.querySelector('.club-mail-decision-badge,.club-mail-saved-badge,.club-mail-important');
    const copy=row.querySelector('.club-mail-row-copy');
    const rr=row.getBoundingClientRect();
    const br=badge.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cr=copy.getBoundingClientRect();
    const rs=getComputedStyle(row);
    const bs=getComputedStyle(badge);
    const requiredPadding=state==='decision'?95:51;
    return {
      state,
      row:{left:rr.left,right:rr.right,width:rr.width,clientWidth:row.clientWidth,scrollWidth:row.scrollWidth},
      badge:{left:br.left,right:br.right,top:br.top,bottom:br.bottom,width:br.width,position:bs.position,rightStyle:bs.right},
      copy:{left:cr.left,right:cr.right,width:cr.width},
      paddingRight:parseFloat(rs.paddingRight)||0,
      inside:br.left>=rr.left+8-tolerance&&br.right<=rr.right-8+tolerance,
      separated:cr.right<=br.left-8+tolerance,
      centered:Math.abs((br.top+br.bottom)/2-(rr.top+rr.bottom)/2)<=2,
      noRowOverflow:row.scrollWidth<=row.clientWidth+1,
      absolute:bs.position==='absolute',
      inset:Math.abs((parseFloat(bs.right)||0)-12)<=1,
      reserved:(parseFloat(rs.paddingRight)||0)>=requiredPadding
    };
  });
  const result={viewport:innerWidth,rows,documentNoOverflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1};
  document.getElementById('audit-result').textContent=JSON.stringify(result);
});
</script></body></html>
